title: Compute Blade
description: 4-blade Raspberry Pi CM4 compute blade cluster: compute-blade-agent (health, thermals, fans, power, events) plus node_exporter (CPU, memory, network). Agent: modules/compute-blade-agent in SpechtLabs/homelab.

links.title: RPI Dashboard
links.tooltip: Raspberry Pi fleet: firmware, clocks, voltages

panels.title: Blades online
panels.description: Blades whose compute-blade-agent answers the metrics scrape (:9666), out of the four in the chassis.

panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: Worst condition any blade reports right now: critical mode (SoC at 60 °C), a stalled fan, under-voltage, CPU throttling. Identify only means someone asked a blade to blink its LED.

targets.expr: max(max by (instance) ((computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="critical"} * 5) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="fan_stall"} * 4) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="undervoltage"} * 3) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="throttled"} * 2) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="identify"} * 1)))

panels.title: Hottest SoC
panels.description: Highest SoC temperature across the four blades. The fan reaches 100% at 60 °C, which is also where the agent enters critical mode.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of all 16 Cortex-A72 cores (4 per blade) that are busy.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use across the cluster (4 × 8 GB), as 1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Traffic through the blades' gigabit eth0 ports (the PoE+ uplinks), receive plus transmit, all blades.

options.content: blade-pi1Raspberry Pi CM4 · smart fan unit

panels.description: blade-pi1: worst condition the agent reports (critical, fan stall, under-voltage, throttled), or Identify while its edge LED is blinking. Single button press toggles identify; hold 5 s to shut down; 5 quick presses power it off immediately.

targets.expr: max by (instance) ((computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",instance=~"blade-pi1:.*",state="critical"} * 5) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",instance=~"blade-pi1:.*",state="fan_stall"} * 4) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",instance=~"blade-pi1:.*",state="undervoltage"} * 3) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",instance=~"blade-pi1:.*",state="throttled"} * 2) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",instance=~"blade-pi1:.*",state="identify"} * 1))

panels.title: SoC
panels.description: blade-pi1 SoC temperature. Fan curve: 40% at 45 °C, 80% at 55 °C, 100% at 60 °C; critical mode at 60 °C (clears 5 °C below).

panels.title: Fan
panels.description: blade-pi1 smart fan unit speed (RPM over UART). Around 7000 RPM is 100%.
blade-pi1: power source (802.3at PoE+, else 802.3af PoE or USB-C and the CPU is capped at 1200 MHz), air temperature at the smart fan unit, CPU busy, time since boot.

panels.title: Blade state
panels.description: Worst condition per blade over time. Purple is identify mode (LED blinking), green is normal.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (instance) ((computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="critical"} * 5) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="fan_stall"} * 4) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="undervoltage"} * 3) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="throttled"} * 2) or (computeblade_state_state{job="blade_exporter",state="identify"} * 1)), "blade", "$1", "instance", "([^:]+)(:.*)?")

panels.title: SoC temperature
panels.description: SoC temperature per blade. Dashed lines: 55 °C (fan curve at 80%) and 60 °C (fan at 100%, critical mode).

panels.title: Airflow temperature
panels.description: Air temperature measured by each smart fan unit: the air the fan pushes over the blade. The sensor reports whole degrees; 0 °C readings (no smart fan unit detected) are dropped.

panels.title: SoC above airflow
panels.description: How much hotter the SoC runs than the air around it. A rising gap at the same load points at the cooling (heatsink contact, fan, dust), not the room.

panels.title: NVMe temperature
panels.description: Composite temperature of each blade's NVMe SSD (node_exporter hwmon).

panels.title: Fan speed
panels.description: Measured fan speed per blade. Readings above 20000 RPM are dropped: they come from a smart fan unit the agent missed at startup (it then reads UART bytes as tach pulses; fixed in compute-blade-agent 0.11.5).

panels.title: Fan target
panels.description: Fan speed the agent commands from the fan curve: 40% at 45 °C, 80% at 55 °C, 100% at 60 °C (linear in between). Stealth mode would pin it low.

panels.title: Power source
panels.description: 802.3at PoE+ (green) or 802.3af PoE / USB-C (orange; the power policy then caps the CPU at 1200 MHz). Agents up to 0.11.4 label the source 1/0 instead of poe+/poeOrUsbC; both match.

panels.title: CPU limited by power policy
panels.description: Whether the agent's power policy limits the CPU: 1200 MHz cap when not on PoE+, powersave governor during under-voltage.

panels.title: CPU frequency
panels.description: Core clock per blade, averaged over 10 minutes (ondemand governor: 600 MHz idle, 1.5 GHz busy). The dashed line is the 1200 MHz cap the power policy applies off PoE+.

panels.title: Firmware throttling (now)
panels.description: Most serious Raspberry Pi firmware throttle flag active per blade (vcgencmd get_throttled).

panels.title: Throttling since boot
panels.description: Most serious firmware throttle flag seen since each blade booted.

panels.title: CPU cores busy
panels.description: Busy cores per blade, stacked: the top edge is the whole cluster (16 cores).

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use per blade (MemTotal − MemAvailable), stacked: the top edge is the cluster (4 × 8 GB).

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: 1-minute load average divided by the core count. Sustained values above 1 mean work waits for a CPU.

panels.title: Network receive
panels.description: eth0 receive rate per blade, stacked: the top edge is the cluster.

panels.title: Network transmit
panels.description: eth0 transmit rate per blade, stacked: the top edge is the cluster.

panels.title: NVMe root filesystem used
panels.description: Used share of each blade's root filesystem (NVMe). Orange from 80%, red from 90%.

panels.title: Agent events in range
panels.description: Events the agents handled in the selected time range, all blades, by type. `bladectl -A events` streams them live. The counter appears with the first event after an agent restart, so that first one isn't counted.

panels.title: Events per blade
panels.description: Agent events per blade per 15 minutes (or longer on wide time ranges) (button presses, identify, critical, fan stall, power limits). Critical/fan stall and button gestures/power limits are also drawn as annotations on every time chart.
